description: Structured eval definitions for the Lambda Layer Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across layer types (Python Powertools layer, Node.js SDK layer, arm64 Graviton provided.al2023 layer, cross-account sharing, missing prerequisites). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Python Powertools layer with arm64 for multiple Python runtimes
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all checklist items verified, correct zip path (python/), compatible runtimes (python3.10-3.13), arm64 architecture, version ARN, function attachment
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Python Lambda Layer named "my-powertools-layer" in us-east-1. Include aws-lambda-powertools, boto3, and requests. Compatible with python3.10, python3.11, python3.12, and python3.13. Architecture: arm64 only (Graviton). License: MIT. Attach it to function "my-api-fn" which runs on python3.12 + arm64. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LAMBDA_LAYER: my-powertools-layer
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Layer name: my-powertools-layer (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Zip source: local (./layer/my-powertools-layer.zip)
  [✓] Zip structure: python/ (verified: pip install -t python/)
  [✓] Compatible runtimes: python3.10, python3.11, python3.12, python3.13
  [✓] Compatible architectures: arm64
  [✓] Layer size: within 50 MB compressed limit
  [✓] Version: 1 (immutable; ARN: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:layer:my-powertools-layer:1)
  [✓] License info: MIT
  [✓] Cross-account sharing: Same account (no sharing config needed)
  [✓] Function attachment: my-api-fn → layer version 1
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lambda list-layers
  aws lambda get-layer-version --layer-name my-powertools-layer --version-number 1
  aws lambda get-function-configuration --function-name my-api-fn

eval_cases.name: Python layer shared cross-account with resource-based policy + consumer IAM
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — layer shared with account 123456789012 via resource-based policy (add-permission) with consumer IAM noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Python Lambda Layer named "shared-utils-layer" in us-east-1 with numpy and pandas for python3.12. Architecture: x86_64. Share this layer with account 123456789012 so they can attach it to their Lambda functions. License: BSD-3-Clause. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LAMBDA_LAYER: shared-utils-layer
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Layer name: shared-utils-layer (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Zip source: local (./layer/shared-utils-layer.zip)
  [✓] Zip structure: python/ (verified: pip install -t python/)
  [✓] Compatible runtimes: python3.12
  [✓] Compatible architectures: x86_64
  [✓] Layer size: within 50 MB compressed limit
  [✓] Version: 1 (immutable; ARN: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:layer:shared-utils-layer:1)
  [✓] License info: BSD-3-Clause
  [✓] Cross-account sharing: shared with 123456789012 (resource-based policy + consumer IAM lambda:GetLayerVersion)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lambda list-layers
  aws lambda get-layer-version --layer-name shared-utils-layer --version-number 1
  aws lambda get-layer-version-policy --layer-name shared-utils-layer --version-number 1

eval_cases.name: Operator has not specified compatible runtimes or architectures
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — compatible runtimes (path resolution), compatible architectures (x86_64 default vs arm64), and specific dependencies all unspecified
eval_cases.prompt: Help me create a Lambda Layer called "my-deps-layer" in us-east-1. I want to put some Python and Node.js libraries in it and attach it to my functions. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
LAMBDA_LAYER: my-deps-layer
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Compatible runtimes: NOT specified — Lambda layers MUST declare compatible runtimes for correct /opt path resolution and attach-time validation
  [✗] Compatible architectures: NOT specified — default is x86_64; arm64 functions will reject the layer
  [✗] Specific dependencies: NOT specified — drives the zip content and size estimate
  [✗] Target functions: NOT specified — need runtime + architecture to match the layer declarations
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws lambda list-functions --query 'Functions[*].[FunctionName,Runtime,Architectures]' --output text
  aws lambda list-layers
